title.value: ci: drop the aggregator job; the required checks name the jobs directly

body.value:
<!-- pr-body:v1 -->
<!-- markdownlint-disable MD041 -->
## Intent

One CI shape in every repo. The operator's ruling (2026-09-27): "we retain a unified universal CI, no meaningless public vs private fragmentation."

This repo's ruleset now requires `ci / checks` and each of its own `ci / <job>` checks directly. That's lexijamesesq/dotty#379, merged and converged. So the `ci / all-passed` aggregator gates nothing, and it costs a runner start on every PR.

## What changed

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`: the `all-checks-passed` job and the comment block directly above it are removed.

## Verification

- The live ruleset on the default branch requires: `trusted-scan / trusted-scan`, `ci / release-check`, `ci / checks`, `ci / validate-and-test`, `ci / drift-check`, `ci / standalone-check`. `ci / all-passed` is not among them.
- Every one of those checks reports from this workflow or from trusted-scan.
- The estate tool (`ci-caller-merge.py`) is idempotent on the result, so a future caller rollout won't change it.
- actionlint is clean.

## Risk and blast radius

This repo's CI only. A job the floor skips on a mechanical PR reports "skipped", which satisfies a required check. A failed floor fails `ci / checks`.

## Rollback

Revert this PR.

## Ticket

None. This is an operator ruling from the session.

## Dependencies

lexijamesesq/dotty#379 (merged, converged).
